The big man has yet to make his season debut due to a lumbar spine bone stress response, and he isn't expected to return until mid-November at the earliest.

comment: Goodwin (calf) won't play in Wednesday's game against Portland.
detail: Goodwin suffered a calf injury in Monday's 116-113 loss to the Warriors. His next chance to return will come Thursday versus Orlando. In the meantime, Luke Kennard could be on the floor more than usual.

comment: Pritchard exited Wednesday's 109-102 win over the Bucks and did not return due to a right eye abrasion, finishing with 10 points (4-7 FG, 2-2 FT), five assists and one rebound across 18 minutes.
detail: Pritchard was deemed questionable to return but never checked back in. He can be considered questionable for Friday's game at Charlotte, and if he's forced to miss time, Baylor Scheierman and Mike Conley would be candidates for increased playing time.

comment: Collins (undisclosed) exited to the locker room in the fourth quarter of Wednesday's 135-105 loss to the Knicks, finishing with three points (1-4 FG, 0-2 3Pt, 1-1 FT), three assists, one rebound and one steal across 14 minutes.
detail: Collins headed back to the locker room with a trainer and did not return. He can be considered questionable for Sunday's game against the Sixers until the Bulls offer an update on his status. If the big man is forced to miss time, Leonard Miller could see increased burn.

comment: Allen (knee) exited to the locker room in the first quarter of Wednesday's 124-116 loss to the Thunder and did not return, finishing with zero points (0-1 FG) and one rebound in seven minutes.
detail: Allen exited to the locker room with a right knee injury. The big man was deemed doubtful to return and did not check back in. If he needs to miss time, Thomas Bryant would likely see increased playing time behind Evan Mobley. Mario Hezonja could also see an uptick in minutes.

comment: Proctor exited Wednesday's 124-116 loss to the Thunder in the fourth quarter and did not return due to an apparent ankle injury, finishing with 11 points (4-7 FG, 2-3 3Pt, 1-1 FT), one rebound and one steal across 22 minutes.
detail: Proctor got the starting nod for the first time this season and for just the second time in his career. He turned in a respectable performance on the offensive end but exited to the locker room late in the fourth quarter. The second-year guard can be considered questionable for Friday's game against the Sixers until Cleveland provides an update on his status. If Proctor needs to miss time, Meleek Thomas and Craig Porter could see increased burn.

comment: Stewart (knee) exited Wednesday's 107-103 loss to the Pacers and did not return, finishing with six points (3-4 FG) and one rebound in 10 minutes.
detail: Stewart was deemed doubtful to return and never checked back in. His next chance to suit up will come Friday against the Thunder. If the big man needs to miss time, Quinten Post would likely see an uptick in minutes.

comment: Bona exited Wednesday's 112-106 win over the Pistons in the fourth quarter and did not return due to an apparent head injury, finishing with five points (2-4 FG, 1-1 FT), two rebounds, one assist and one steal across 15 minutes.
detail: Bona headed back to the locker room with trainers and never checked back in. The big man can be considered questionable ahead of Friday's game at Cleveland.

comment: Head coach Micah Nori said that Krejci suffered a left leg fracture during Wednesday's 132-119 win over the Suns, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.
detail: Nori did not provide a timetable for Krejci, but it's safe to say that he won't be back soon. His minutes figure to be divvied up amongst Chris Youngblood and Sidy Cissoko.

comment: Johnson (ankle) is listed as out for Wednesday's game in Washington.
detail: Johnson sustained a sprained left ankle in Saturday's 121-99 loss to the Pelicans and wasn't available for Monday's meeting with Indiana. Now that the 24-year-old is ruled out for a second consecutive game, his next opportunity to get back on the floor will come Friday for the rematch with the Wizards. Without Johnson, Luguentz Dort is expected to stay in the starting lineup.

comment: Tatum will be rested Wednesday against the Bucks, Jack Simone of BostonSportsJournal.com reports.
detail: The writing was on the wall for this one with the Celtics looking to get Tatum some planned rest. There's been no report of an injury, to be clear. Paul George, who is coming off a maintenance day himself, is in line for a big bump in usage Wednesday.

comment: Clowney (knee) supplied seven points (3-6 FG, 1-4 3Pt), one rebound and one assist over 17 minutes during Wednesday's 114-104 victory over the Hornets.
detail: Despite playing in all eight games thus far, Clowney has been mostly a non-factor for the Nets. In 21.0 minutes per game, Clowney has averaged just 5.6 points and 4.4 rebounds, barely making him a top 300 player. Outside of very deep leagues, there is no reason to pay any attention to Clowney.

comment: Murphy (knees) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against Utah.
detail: Murphy was listed as probable initially. However, after being downgraded to questionable, he will now be sidelined for the first time in 2026-27. With Murphy ruled out, Saddiq Bey and Herbert Jones should see more minutes off the bench.

comment: Williams (back) is listed as out for Wednesday's game versus Cleveland, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.
detail: Williams started in Monday's 117-112 victory over the Cavaliers. However, he won't be out there for the rematch Wednesday, marking his first absence of the 2026-27 campaign. With Jalen Williams (leg) and Chet Holmgren (knee) also sidelined, Micah Peavy, Kenrich Williams and Aday Mara should see more minutes than usual.

comment: Orlando recalled Isaac (knee) from the G League's Osceola Magic on Wednesday.
detail: Isaac was assigned to Osceola but recalled again on the same day while he continued his recovery from a knee issue. Having yet to play this season, the forward is not expected to find a meaningful role in the short term, and he'll likely appear on the bench when he's available again.
